records.description: First (maker) comment: "Hi PH! We built Benzaiten LMS to make IT upskilling simple and self-paced. Six courses — Python, AWS, AI/ML with Agile, DevOps, Java, React — each with lifetime access and a certificate on completion. Registration is free; you pay only when you enroll. We'd love your feedback."

records.name: BeatMind · Get inside the music
records.tagline: Agentic AI for music construction and deconstruction
records.description: Drop in a song or start from a prompt. BeatMind separates it into five editable stems, maps every section and chord, and hands it back as a project you can work in.

records.name: StreamProof
records.tagline: Verify the source before you trust the stream
records.description: StreamProof adds an independent trust signal to livestreams. Creators display a time-bound, cryptographically signed QR proof, and viewers scan it to verify that the live was actually authorized by the creator. No account is required to scan. Follow creators across platforms instead of being locked to one platform.

records.name: Voicecoach AI
records.tagline: Your AI communication coach for career success
records.description: VoiceCoach AI helps students and professionals improve communication through realistic AI-powered practice. • AI Mock Interviews • GD Simulator with 4 AI participants • Real-time Speech Feedback • IELTS & TOEFL Practice • Hinglish Mode • Achievement Certificates Start free. Upgrade anytime with Pro plans starting at ₹299/month. Website: myvoicecoach.in

records.name: Mini Accountant
records.tagline: Invoices, VAT and taxes - handled by AI. Free.
records.description: Mini Accountant v2 turns invoicing, expenses, VAT and taxes into seconds of work. New: a full redesign, a monthly dashboard (net profit, income, expenses, VAT, tax, cash collection, unpaid invoices), expense tracking, simple or progressive tax scales, an in-app AI agent, and an MCP server - connect Claude or Cursor and run your books from a chat. Plus multi-currency with automatic rates, partial payments, PDF invoices and reports. Free on iOS, Android and web.

records.name: ChirpyDesk Ai Receptionist
records.tagline: 24/7 AI voice receptionist that books calls & captures leads
records.description: 85% of callers who reach voicemail hang up and call a competitor. ChirpyDesk is the 24/7 AI voice receptionist that answers on the 1st ring with human-like voice synthesis (<500ms latency). ⚡ Live Google & Outlook calendar booking ⚡ Instant knowledge base via your website URL ⚡ Smart lead qualification & SMS confirmations ⚡ Warm call transfers for emergencies Forward your existing number in 60 seconds. Never lose another high-value customer or appointment to voicemail.

records.name: Terio
records.tagline: A better environment to make people decisions.
records.description: Terio is an AI-native HR platform for growing UK businesses. Manage disciplinaries, absence, leave, contracts and more through a single conversation.

records.name: Kordio
records.tagline: The control plane for money your software moves
records.description: Kordio is a policy layer for AI agents that can spend money or take actions. Before an action runs, Kordio checks it against your rules and returns an allowed, approval-required, or denied decision. Allowed decisions are signed with a short-lived ES256 JWS that your executor can verify offline.

records.name: Oshippy
records.tagline: Snap a package. Compare USPS & UPS. Print the best label.
records.description: Oshippy turns your phone into a simple shipping desk. Snap a photo of the recipient address and what you’re sending, and Oshippy uses smart package presets to estimate size and weight, compares USPS and UPS commercial rates, and highlights the cheapest option. Pay, print the label, and ship. Built for marketplace sellers, resellers, small businesses, and anyone who ships often.

records.name: Moviexto
records.tagline: Unlimited movies, smarter hints, redefined gameplay
records.description: Moviexto 2.0 is reimagined! Guess the mystery movie by matching 8 attributes - Year, Genres, Cast, Director, Box Office, IMDB Rating, Studio & Content Rating. Get instant color-coded feedback with directional arrows showing exactly how close you are. Play Unlimited Mode anytime with progressive smart hints. A stunning new UI with mobile-first experience makes guessing smoother and more addictive. No more vague guesses - real movie knowledge wins!

records.name: MXT8
records.tagline: Not a playlist. A tape.
records.description: MXT8 turns songs into a two-sided digital music keepsake made for one person. Choose up to eight songs per side, add a note, an optional Memory Place and up to twelve Polaroid-style photos, then gift it with one browser link. Recipients can open it, hand the ordered songs off to Apple Music or Spotify, and keep the tape on their shelf. MXT8 stores the keepsake and music metadata—not commercial music audio. The core Make → Gift → Open → Keep journey is free.

records.name: Anovo: AI Writing Tools
records.tagline: Your all-in-one AI toolkit for smarter work
records.description: Anovo is an all-in-one AI toolkit built to help you write, communicate, and work smarter. Translate content, summarize long text, rewrite with the Paraphraser, improve your writing with Grammar Checker, analyze your writing style with Tone Detector, and transform AI-generated text with AI Humanizer. Use Co-Writer to turn ideas into polished content and AI Chat to brainstorm, learn, and get answers—all in one simple workspace.

records.name: BidPacer 2.0
records.tagline: AI proposals + one-click apply for Upwork, Freelancer, Guru
records.description: One portal for Upwork, Freelancer and Guru. Search all three at once, and BidPacer writes a proposal grounded in your real resume — your projects, your numbers, your voice — then submits it to the platform for you. A Chrome extension fetches listings inside your own logged-in session, so the feed is live, not whatever an API hands over. Plus instant job alerts, application tracking and an AI Resume Studio. Free forever: unlimited proposals, 20 searches and applies a month.

records.name: Gainmaps.com – Stunning colors for UI
records.tagline: Convert text and images to “Ultra” mode, aka HDR gain maps
records.description: Saw this effect, learned about the effect, built tools so you can do it too. It was concerning to see how we missed this effect for so long. It was tied up with HDR, but the whole point is that milage may vary when it comes to the actual implementation and display. Gain maps is the key and this will move us there as an industry. Since there’s many names for this effect, I’m trying to trend that we call it “ultra,” ultra text, ultra images, and ultra dark mode. Join me on this journey!

records.name: LEGER_OS
records.tagline: Personal finance with paycheck cycle burn modeling
records.description: LEGER_OS is an anti-aggregator personal finance mainframe. It tracks liquidity across actual salary deposit cycles rather than rigid calendar months, forecasts future cash flow using recency-decay spending velocity, captures live transactions via zero-credential Android notifications and Apple Pay shortcuts, and tracks multi-asset wealth without third-party bank logins or gamified scores.

records.name: SpaceCheck.app
records.tagline: Turn Furniture photos into 360deg 3D models & True-Scale AR
records.description: SpaceCheck.app helps furniture retailers turn a single product photo into an interactive 3D model and true-scale AR experience in minutes. Upload a photo, enter the real dimensions, generate the 3D model with AI, and let customers visualise furniture in their own space before buying. No 3D designer or customer app required. Built for ecommerce with Shopify integration, shareable AR links, QR codes, and GLB/USDZ downloads.

records.name: Pikwisely — Know Before You Sell
records.tagline: Paste reviews, get a verdict. Source smarter, not harder.
records.description: Paste product reviews and get an instant AI analysis report — sentiment breakdown, top complaints, strengths, and actionable insights in seconds. Built for dropshippers, resellers, and ecommerce sellers who are tired of sourcing blind — validate product-market fit and customer demand before you buy stock or list it in your store.

records.name: PAMAwatch
records.tagline: Check your lab's PAMA reporting exposure, free
records.description: PAMAwatch reads your independent clinical lab's own CY2024 Medicare Clinical Laboratory billing (by NPI or name) against PAMA's public $12,500 reporting threshold, straight from CMS data. No account, no pricing, just the comparison CMS built the rule on.

records.name: Pack Lightly
records.tagline: Travel prepared, not overpacked
records.description: Independent country guides for 146 destinations worldwide. Real 2026 budgets, tested routes, packing lists, and opinionated advice, backed by 22 travel tools.

records.name: Orbit
records.tagline: Context-aware radial command wheel for macOS
records.description: Orbit brings your entire workflow to your cursor with a dynamic radial command wheel. 🚀 Context-Aware: Automatically adapts tools to your active app (Figma, Xcode, Browser) ⚡ Instant Access: Launch apps, websites, Apple Shortcuts & clipboard snippets 📦 Workspace Presets: Open multi-app setups in 1 click 🎨 Fluid Shaders: Obsidian Glass, Matrix Rain, Retro HUD with haptics Built natively in Swift for butter-smooth 120Hz performance. Keep your hands on flow state!
